assumptions: Mission effects and delayed-effect timing unchanged from v1 (delayed effects of mission k applied once at end of mission k+1; M8 delayed effects applied at end of M8).

Failure thresholds: Oxygen<20, Water<20, LSI<50, Crew Health<50, Power reaches 0, Equipment<50 (Cooling removed; Radiation Safety renamed Crew Health). Checks after decision effects and after delayed+consumption.
Star thresholds: 3 stars >=66, 2 stars >=60, 1 star >=50. Final score = average of 7 resources (Cooling removed); below 50 or any immediate failure = failed.
Failed runs report resources at the moment of failure.

decision_commentary: each decision compared with the other options for the same mission with other missions held fixed. 3-star: best decisions only; 2-star: best and worst; 1-star: one good (not best) plus highlighted bad; failed: worst decisions only.
